propositions: The generator recognises only os.environ.get, os.environ[...], and os.getenv forms when scanning for environment variable reads; all other attribute access forms like os.environ.pop are silently skipped without diagnostic or warning.

Refactoring an environment read from os.environ.get to os.environ.pop silently drops the key from the generated docs/env-vars.md registry while the build passes, violating the stated invariant that new env-var reads cannot ship undocumented.

The current narrow recogniser set allows a reproducible one-token edit (get→pop) to reduce the documented registry from 162 to 161 keys without any build signal or exit code change, making the defect latent but reproducible on demand.
The local make lint target does not detect stale or incomplete environment registries; only the full test suite catches it, creating disagreement between local and CI verdicts.

The generator must classify every os.environ attribute access as either key-bearing or bulk, raising an exception for unrecognised forms to fail closed rather than silently omitting keys for unforeseen access patterns.
